title: ORCHID examples: runnable workflows on the ORCHID CALPHAD data (PhaseForge+, ESPEI, one-shot MLIP phase diagrams, MLIP formation enthalpies, quickstart)
description: Runnable, documented examples of the workflows described in the ORCHID paper, each rebuildable in minutes without a GPU from cached outputs: tuning an MLIP-informed Cu-Zr CALPHAD description with gradient-based ESPEI against ORCHID data (PhaseForge+), the classic ESPEI MCMC route as a documented negative example, prevalence-weighted scoring of one-shot MLIP phase diagrams against ORCHID evidence, the saturation of MLIP formation-enthalpy accuracy at the DFT level, and a quickstart notebook. Each example pins the ORCHID release commit and its software versions.
